system.description:
Subtle in the doing if not in its effect, Flick lets you focus your full monstrous strength into the tiniest gesture — a flicked finger that lands like a wrecking ball.

With merely a small gesture toward a visible target, spend a Blood Trait to deliver a devastating blow without touching them. If the target is aware of the attack, win a normal Physical Challenge with the target bidding three extra Traits for the difficulty of dodging an unseen strike; if the target is unaware and in incidental physical contact, no challenge is needed. Flick deals your normal hand-to-hand damage and bonuses, and may be combined with other Potence powers such as Earthshock; onlookers may notice the link between your gestures and the destruction by winning a Static Mental Challenge.
